verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the sandbox docs, which say developers can 'test verification outcomes with magic SSN values' against the same endpoints as Live. That implies a programmatic identity-verification (KYC) flow exists for custodial features, but no KYC/KYB endpoint or onboarding flow is itself documented in the pack. Missing for 10: documented KYC/KYB endpoints, business (KYB) verification, recipient/counterparty clearance before payouts, verification status gating of send/receive, and independent corroboration.
